title: Affine Normal Directions via Log-Determinant Geometry: Scalable Computation under Sparse Polynomial Structure
summary: Affine normal directions provide intrinsic affine-invariant descent directions derived from the geometry of level sets. Their practical use, however, has long been hindered by the need to evaluate third-order derivatives and invert tangent Hessians, which becomes computationally prohibitive in high dimensions. In this paper, we show that affine normal computation admits an exact reduction to second-order structure: the classical third-order contraction term is precisely the gradient of the log-determinant of the tangent Hessian.
